behaviors.search-assignees: Search the Assignee menu by a person’s name and see matching choices with task counts.
behaviors.filter-by-assignee: Choose a person or Unassigned to show only tasks assigned to that choice.
behaviors.combine-filters: Apply an assignee filter together with a status filter to narrow the task list.
behaviors.empty-assignee-state: Choose Ana Lima to see the new message that nothing is assigned to her yet, with a Clear filters action.
behaviors.clear-filters: Clear active filters to restore all statuses and assignees.
